crossRefs.note: To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go…
You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.
Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying…

translations.web: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
translations.bsb: O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.
translations.kjv: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
translations.asv: O God, keep not thou silence: Hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
